overall: Read the passage as one connected account, dry and plain, like someone who knows the record and is telling you what it says. Open brisk and curious, drop to a plainer level on the companies' claim, lift for the regulator's dated decision and the inspector's review, keep the limits exact, and close lowest and most even. Breaths fall at complete clauses and full stops, never after a preposition, and no date, figure or qualifier is split.
performance_arc: Plain and even at the pad, a little drier at the claim, steady through the record, and slower and level on the last two lines.

text:
In the Permian Basin, Chevron tested autonomous drones from a company located in Austin.
The companies say AI alerts when it detects anomalies to normal operations.
On September 30th, 2025, the Environmental Protection Agency approved that company's Air Max drone system for periodic methane screening.
The drone carries an infrared camera and follows a flight plan to points of interest.
Then a certified inspector reviews the footage to identify any emissions, which triggers a follow-up inspection.
The approval letter mentions AI only in the title of a protocol.
EPA also delayed a separate leak reporting program to January 22nd, 2027,
and on October 7th said it will propose to rescind it.
Under this approval, a certified inspector confirms the leak. The letter doesn't say what the AI adds.

defects.finding: The line says the company is 'located in Austin' with no qualifier. Claim c1 quotes EPA's letter, which says Austin, Texas. Its scope note says the attached EPA memo also says the company is based in Modi'in, Israel and Austin, Texas. The qualifier is missing from the spoken line.
defects.decision: Director judgment on a source-limit change. Any change to the text is a complete story correction, which requires a new direction file. Budget: the packet records storyboard_critics at 4 of the 5 counted review rounds, and the owner's rule keeps the final timed phone review inside that limit. A corrected story therefore cannot take a fresh paid critic and still keep the timed phone review inside the limit without the director's explicit budget decision.

defects.finding: script_evidence_check was not run in this session because no shell tool was available. build_prompt runs it and refuses before any call. Date formats differ from the quotes: the script says 'January 22nd, 2027' and c9 says 'January 22, 2027'. The script says 'September 30th, 2025' and c11 says 'September 30, 2025'. 'Leak reporting program' in line 7 matches no quote (see D8).
defects.decision: Run scripts/script_evidence_check.py against the board and claims and read its exit code. A refusal means a story correction, not a silent edit.
